verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that individual transcription requests return JSON and that the model can be installed and run locally via pip. Neither is a documented capability to export all of a user's stored data in open formats and migrate away. Per-request JSON output and local install are adjacent features, not an account-level data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
